title: MACO - generasia
text: To promote her talent, MACO began publishing Japanese covers of songs by western artists such as Taylor Swift, Katy Perry, and Ariana Grande. The videos garnered 6 million views in just 5 months. In April 2014, she released her first indie mini-album 22, which topped the iTunes charts. She was subsequently signed by Universal Music Japan and followed up with a second mini-album release 23 which also topped the digital charts and reached #10 on the weekly Oricon charts.
